title: Dragon Ball Z: Idainaru Dragon Ball Densetsu
native_title: ドラゴンボールＺ ～偉大なるドラゴン・ボール伝説～
overview:
Super battles, finally realized!

Goku's Kamehameha and Piccolo's Special Beam Cannon explode in polygons! Hammer your enemies with a Super Rush of amazing combo moves!

Relive the great battles of Dragon Ball Z in team fights of up to three fighters per side. Characters fly freely around a 3D arena, trading rapid punches, kicks and ki blasts and swapping in teammates mid-match. Watch your ki - use it all and your fighter is left exhausted and wide open.

- Story mode split into episodes covering the major battles of the series
- Recreate events from the anime to unlock extra scenes and characters
- Single-player and two-player play

ついに実現した超バトル!

悟空のかめはめ波が、ピッコロの魔貫光殺砲がポリゴンで炸裂！ 驚異の連続技で、敵にスーパーラッシュを叩きこめ！
